pr.title: Prevent initial order admission from replaying owned work
pr.body:
An initial Issue proposal could be re-read after owner progress and restart failed work through legacy scheduling semantics. The real loop now checks an optional owner-issued initial revision before promotion and commits first-admission identity in its existing effect ledger. Removing an order from active work cannot make it new initial work again; legacy explicit restart/amendment remains supported.

Validation on head `75ae4f12808004cfc83d39b8306234e94d9e3ef3`: full `pnpm check` passed with clean source; exact-head Test run [35115224453](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/actions/runs/35115224453) passed. A child process is killed after durable admission and before proposal deletion, then the owner reloads from disk and refuses replay. Six narrowly removed enforcement controls fail against the same frozen observer; corrected controls and legal legacy/independent work pass. [Immutable evidence](https://github.com/ed3c/noodle/tree/e7d37d4bf5dc6005f5d1eb5e342c4b97e4749442/evidence/82/initial-admission).

These are real local owner controls over temporary state; worker/provider adapters in them are test doubles. This supplies Noodle's ownership boundary for Soodles #18, whose real consumers, authorization, worker revalidation and delivery remain separate.

Refs ed3c/noodle#82

issue.title: Bind initial order proposals to canonical ownership before promotion
issue.body:
## Causal boundary

Soodles #18 requires initial Issue admission to remain initial admission when a producer races owner progress or an interrupted proposal is read again. Noodle's current orders-next consumer intentionally allows legacy active proposals to restart failed work and amend active work. A physically executed external Go overlay against e6d712a2512547cdf78a85c1ee218e1ba52e3b27 reproduced failed → active with one dispatchable stage when the exact initial proposal bytes were replayed; independent first admission passed. This is a new conditional-admission capability, not a claim that legacy restart behavior violated its former contract.

Owner: Noodle's canonical order and proposal consumer. This is a separate repository/durable owner from Soodles #18 and must not be appended to the completed Codex launch Issue #78.

## Admitted implementation

Extend the existing orders-next wire format with an optional initial-admission precondition bound to an owner-issued order revision. This value is concurrency evidence, never authorization or an Agent-selected execution policy. When present, the owner must require the current revision and absence of every proposed non-schedule ID before any promotion. Existing legacy proposals and explicit control requeue/amendment behavior retain their contracts.

Persist the order revision within the existing canonical snapshot, changing it when the non-schedule ownership set changes. Retain it across scheduling, ordinary stage progress and process restart. A missing old-snapshot revision cannot authorize conditional admission; the owner creates a revision on its next canonical checkpoint. A consumed proposal cannot become initial work again after completion/removal returns the active set to its earlier shape. A successful initial admission also records a completed effect in Noodle's existing effect ledger, atomically with its order. That owner record survives order removal so a fresh notification/revision cannot create the same initial work again. Legacy explicit recovery remains separate. No second ledger, lock, scheduler or retry engine.

Exact initial source boundary: internal/orderx/compact.go, internal/reducer/snapshot.go, internal/reducer/types.go, loop/types.go, loop/canonical_checkpoint.go, loop/orders.go, loop/loop_cycle_pipeline.go, loop/initial_admission_test.go, internal/orderx/compact_test.go, internal/schemadoc/specs.go. Adjust existing directly affected call sites/tests only after recording the exact expanded boundary in this Issue. Any API/schema help required by this field belongs to this same causal atom. Target Soodles producer/worker enforcement remains #18.

Base: delivered main 9cdb919826eb6ef25bbb47978ae4d398332cb9ed. Carrier: the exact native Noodle / macOS / Codex identity proven in #78; no model session is needed for these deterministic owner controls. Noodle owns the isolated implementation worktree. Normal pnpm check and expected-head provider delivery remain required; no bypass/protection changes.

## Acceptance and controls

Use the actual Loop merge/promotion/persist/load path, not two mock wrappers:
- Initial proposal admitted once; same proposal after failed work, active amendment attempt, completion/removal, and process restart cannot dispatch again or replace owned work.
- A fresh independently authorized different Issue using current owner readback may enter.
- Missing/malformed/stale precondition names the invalid input and required fresh owner readback, with absent promotion/worker effects.
- Crash after canonical promotion but before deleting proposal retains safety on recovery.
- Legacy unconditioned restart/amendment and explicit requeue remain legal non-cases.
- Defect RED must be the same observer failing on baseline or narrowly removed enforcement; correction GREEN and nearest legal non-case GREEN must be retained.

This issue is not complete from unit tests alone: self-review, canonical checks, exact provider merge/closure and local Noodle reconciliation remain required. Soodles #18 still must integrate real automatic/supervised consumers and worker revalidation; this API alone does not complete #18.
